summary: Verification instructions under-build the private checker dependencies
evidence: The Quick start instructs only `dune build --root . @install` at docs/arch-guard.md:8-13, while the verification commands at docs/arch-guard.md:82-109 require private, deliberately non-installed probe executables. The independent `owned` checker proves four such probes are required (`probes:4`) and the full build supplies them. Thus a reader following the documented build command before the documented checker list can receive a setup error despite a correct installable CLI.
fix: Before the verification command block, state the exact project-switch full-build prerequisite: `rtk proxy opam exec --switch=/home/mathias/dev/arch-index -- dune build --root .`; retain @install as the lightweight CLI quick-start path if desired.
boundary: documented CLI quick-start to private verification probes
invariant: Every documented verification command has its required build artifacts after the documented prerequisite.
failure_mode: A clean checkout built only through @install has the public CLI but lacks the private probes consumed by the listed checker modes, producing a checker setup failure.
